ana: drafting a compact hybrid manager checklist (first week + 30/60/90). want it to include clear escalation paths for remote hires. pls review.

liam: love it. add a note to confirm timezone overlaps for pairing sessions during week1.

tara: add a quick Day1 1:1 agenda: intro, comms prefs, working hours, immediate blockers, 3-week priorities. also mention hardware escalation: ping #it-ops if laptop delayed >48h.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Day1 checklist will auto-send to manager and buddy 24h before start.

ana: putting the paste-ready checklist below. keep short for manager emails.

```
Manager hybrid kickoff (paste-ready)
Pre-start: open IT ticket for laptop/SSO (target 5 business days), assign buddy, share role doc + OKRs, confirm timezone overlap windows for pairing.
Day1: HR (payroll/benefits), 20m manager 1:1 (expectations, comms prefs, working hours, blockers), team intro, buddy-led tech check.
By EOW: confirm dev access, run basic workflow, assign small deliverable, review 30/60/90 draft, schedule skip-level and week2 customer shadow.
Escalations: #it-ops for hardware/SSO, people-ops for payroll, #security for compliance.
```

liam: looks good. can we pin the role doc link in Notion?

tara: yep will pin and publish. thanks all.
